profile.name: Niladri Roy
profile.headline: I like making hard systems feel calm.
profile.intro: Eleven years on enterprise software at Visa, Informatica and Salesforce. Outside work I run my own small infrastructure, write, and take photographs.

employers.name: Salesforce
employers.note: The Informatica MDM team moved to Salesforce with the acquisition. Same product and team, new parent company.

roles.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
roles.summary: Came over with the acquisition and became the person the hardest customer bugs land on: two P1s at once, and a validation leak three layers deep.

projects.title: Two concurrent P1 escalations
projects.description: Two customer-blocking P1s at the same time, on top of a steady load of around 21 open issues: a dependent picklist that stayed greyed out after an enrichment rule filled its parent from another section, fixed in the UI and shipped as an emergency patch, and a data-quality validation error that kept resurfacing after the failing section of the record was deleted.

projects.title: A validation leak, three layers deep
projects.description: Root-caused and fixed a multi-layered data-quality validation leak for an enterprise customer, tracing it through each layer instead of patching the symptom. Took it through two rounds of architect review, including correcting a design that assumed the failure couldn't happen, and shipped it behind a feature flag across two services.

projects.title: Transition mapping in the config UI
projects.description: Built transition mapping in the config UI end to end, the feature that lets a rule pull field inputs from a related business entity, covering both the create-and-edit path and the read-only view from the design spec. Then kept it solid under real use: a P1 fixed as an emergency patch, plus five more mapping-correctness fixes, including a bounded, cycle-safe redesign of how referenced fields expand and a read-side bug that would have let a save silently fail while still looking right.

projects.title: Lenient validation for draft records
projects.description: Delivered the semantics that let a draft record save even when some rules fail, across every combination of the enable-rejection and reject-on-failure toggles, and backed it with a full test matrix. Shipped in the 2026.04 release.

employers.name: Informatica
employers.note: Master Data Management R&D. MDM is how large companies keep one trusted record of each customer, product and supplier.

roles.title: Principal Software Engineer
roles.summary: Senior IC across MDM UI and services. Took Dynamic Fields from design doc to production on the date we committed to.

projects.title: Dynamic fields in workflows
projects.description: Led design and delivery of an epic that lets reviewers see and edit dynamic field definitions and values inside a workflow. Shipped on schedule, with quality and performance intact, to production in October.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer
roles.summary: Four years that started with rescuing a fragile editor and ended with AI enrichment on the Informatica World stage.

projects.title: AI enrichment integration
projects.description: Brought AI-generated enrichment into the MDM product lifecycle. Showcased at Informatica World 2023, where it contributed to a sales lift of more than 20%. Work spanned UI, backend service, model serving, BPEL and Elasticsearch tuning, plus parallel prediction for batch jobs.

projects.title: Enrichment with LLMs
projects.description: Worked across teams to rebuild the enrichment framework so it could call multiple external systems, including fine-tuned internal LLMs based on ChatGPT.

projects.title: Audit trail performance
projects.description: Added Elasticsearch batching for import jobs and measured it with A/B performance metrics. Brought search, lifecycle management, disaster recovery and eventual consistency. Operating cost fell 30% and response times improved by more than 50%.

projects.title: New enrichment microservice
projects.description: Created and onboarded a new MDM microservice across DevOps, Security, Platform Integration and feature teams, and documented every step. The next team to onboard a service used the wiki and did it in under half the time.

projects.title: Sequential Edit stabilization
projects.description: Joined a bug-prone UI feature after COVID, made architectural changes, and brought component-library owners in early. PR reviews got faster and the feature shipped within months.

projects.title: 2023 AI Hackathon
projects.description: Mentored three teams across text, image and audio, and built a ChatGPT integration into the MDM platform that reached the finals.

projects.title: DaaS enrichment enablement
projects.description: Built a UI framework for configurable DaaS services that enrich records on demand. It became a platform feature used across teams.

projects.title: Germany office collaboration
projects.description: Worked on site with the German office on planning for Dynamic Fields and the CLAIRE platform.

projects.title: Crystal theme upgrade
projects.description: Delivered a theme upgrade for on-premise P360 with PM and UX.

projects.title: Interview panels
projects.description: Assessed candidates on technical skill, teamwork and ability to learn.

projects.title: Operational excellence
projects.description: Fixed bugs, led the team through releases, and took on-call production support.

employers.name: Visa
employers.note: Corporate IT, building internal platforms for revenue, pricing and engineering analytics.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.summary: Moved a global invoicing portal to modern Angular, started an internal tech forum, and began teaching across the org.

projects.title: VOIP moves to Angular 6
projects.description: Led the migration of the Visa Online Invoice Portal frontend to Angular 6 for performance, compatibility and security, backed by thorough testing.

projects.title: Ready to Return mentoring
projects.description: Mentored women in technology returning to the workplace after a career break.

projects.title: Visa Tech Forum and One Intake
projects.description: Started Visa Tech Forum, a platform for technical discussion that pulls from several sources, and contributed heavily to One Intake, a wrapper app for vendor and project requests.

projects.title: Global OpCerts
projects.description: UI improvements, performance work and code-quality monitoring on a major, well-funded EAA application.

projects.title: Tech talks
projects.description: Gave organization-wide talks on Angular, React with Redux, SCSS, and Node.js with Express.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.summary: First job: built the portal that invoices Visa’s member banks worldwide, and on the side wrote a library that now has 5M+ downloads.

projects.title: Visa Online Invoice Portal
projects.description: Helped build the portal that generates invoices for member banks worldwide. Set up Jenkins CI/CD on a dedicated build server and kept it compatible back to IE7. Live globally as of 2020.

projects.title: js-big-decimal
projects.description: Published an npm package for exact decimal arithmetic in JavaScript, for very large and very small numbers. More than 5 million downloads so far.

principles.title: Write it down
principles.body: I documented how to onboard a new MDM microservice, end to end. The next team used that wiki and finished in under half the time.

principles.title: Bring owners in early
principles.body: When Sequential Edit kept breaking, I brought the component-library owners in before writing code. Reviews got shorter and the feature shipped within months.

principles.title: Measure, then argue
principles.body: Performance work ships with before-and-after numbers, like the A/B metrics behind the audit trail changes.
